name: @tibame201020/queqiao-adb

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

contributions.title: List ADB devices
contributions.description: List bounded Android devices visible to the Worker ADB daemon.

contributions.title: Read ADB device info
contributions.description: Read bounded model, Android version, display size, and density for one ADB device.

contributions.title: List Android packages
contributions.description: List bounded installed Android package names on one ADB device.

contributions.title: Read foreground Android app
contributions.description: Read the current resumed Android package and activity from one ADB device.

contributions.title: Capture Android screenshot
contributions.description: Capture a screenshot through ADB, create a bounded JPEG preview, and return base64 image data. The source PNG is deleted after conversion.

contributions.title: Start Android app
contributions.description: Start one installed Android package through the standard monkey launcher intent.

contributions.title: Stop Android app
contributions.description: Force-stop one Android package on the selected ADB device.

contributions.title: Tap Android screen
contributions.description: Send one bounded tap to the selected ADB device.

contributions.title: Swipe Android screen
contributions.description: Send one bounded swipe gesture to the selected ADB device.

contributions.title: Send Android key event
contributions.description: Send one bounded numeric Android key event to the selected ADB device.

description: Bounded Android Debug Bridge extension for Queqiao Workers
